 Up for a challenge? Test your knowledge on the biggest events in the investing world over the past week. Take the latest Seeking Alpha News Quiz and see how you stack up against the competition. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Top News
 
 
 
 Wall Street ended the week in the red after Oracle’s ( ORCL ) earnings beat, a nearly 20-basis-point jump in the U.S. 10 Year Treasury yield ( US10Y ), and the latest consumer price index inflation report landing.

Oracle ( ORCL ) was in focus on the earnings front after the IT giant reported fiscal first-quarter results and guidance that topped analyst estimates by a significant margin.

 U.S. Treasury yields jumped across the curve this week, with the benchmark U.S. 10 Year Treasury yield ( US10Y ) climbing nearly 20 basis points to 4.97%.U.S. CPI inflation rose 0.4% M/M in August, matching Wall Street estimates and accelerating from July’s 0.1% gain, according to Friday’s Bureau of Labor Statistics data release.

For the week, the blue-chip Dow ( DJI ) fell -1.57%, the benchmark S&P ( SP500 ) lost -0.80%, and the tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite ( COMP:IND ) handed back -0.66%. Read a preview of next week's major events in Seeking Alpha's Catalyst Watch .


 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
New Technology
 
 
 
 Battlefield outlook 
 
 
 
Seeking Alpha
 
 
New frontiers are emerging on the battlefield, with countries increasingly investing in laser weapons, space warfare and even humanoid robots. From using a high-energy laser weapon system to down suspicious drones along the Mexico border to practicing "orbital dogfighting," the U.S. is pulling out all the stops to maintain its edge in the race for new military technologies. Read more.

Oxford Industries' ( OXM ) Turnaround Progress Is Minimal .

Circle ( CRCL ): Lock In Gains As USDC Circulation Slows .

HF Sinclair's ( DINO ) Price Can No Longer Be Justified .
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Weekly Movement U.S. Indices 
Dow -1.6% to 52,573. S&P 500 -0.8% to 7,657. Nasdaq -0.7% to 26,333. Russell 2000 -2.4% to 2,904. CBOE Volatility Index +9.% to 15.84. 

 S&P 500 Sectors 
Consumer Staples -0.6% . Utilities - 1.7% . Financials -1.5% . Telecom +1.1% . Healthcare -3.6% . Industrials -1.7% . Information Technology -0.2% . Materials -2.7% . Energy +2% . Consumer Discretionary -1.2% . Real Estate -1% . 

 World Indices 
London -1.7% to 10,650. France -1.2% to 8,180. Germany -1.8% to 25,569. Japan -1.6% to 64,011. China -1.1% to 3,888. Hong Kong -3.3% to 24,806. India -2.3% to 74,782. 

 Commodities and Bonds 
Crude Oil WTI +9.3% to $99.99/bbl. Gold -1.9% to $4,390./oz. Natural Gas -5.2% to 2.82. Ten-Year Bond Yield -0.2 bps to 4.975. 

 Forex and Cryptos 
EUR/USD -0.13% . USD/JPY -1.75% . GBP/USD +0.03% . Bitcoin -3.4% . Litecoin -1.8% . Ethereum +1.2% . XRP -3.5% . 

 Top S&P 500 Gainers 
Skyworks Solutions ( SWKS ) +24% . Coherent ( COHR ) +15% . Hewlett Packard Enterprise ( HPE ) +14% . Corning ( GLW ) +14% . Advanced Micro Devices ( AMD ) +13% . 

 Top S&P 500 Losers 
The Cooper Companies ( COO ) -24% . Casey's General Stores ( CASY ) -19% . Lululemon Athletica ( LULU ) -19% . FactSet Research Systems ( FDS ) -17% . Amgen ( AMGN ) -15% .
